name: Kabilio
what: Generative-AI platform for Spanish accounting and tax firms that automates document collection, invoice processing and bookkeeping with their clients.
homonym_note: Google News hits for 'Kabilio' also name the Israeli football club Maccabi Kabilio Jaffa and musician Elad Kabilio; unrelated.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026); Visionaries Club co-led the Nov 2025 pre-seed.
membership.quote: €4 million pre-seed round led by Visionaries Club and Picus Capital

entry.quote: has closed a €4 million pre-seed round led by Visionaries Club and Picus Capital

graduation_surfaces: googlenews: "Kabilio" -> only the Nov 2025 pre-seed (tech.eu, eu-startups, TFN, capital-riesgo, Pulse 2.0); no later round through 2026-09-30
notes: Pre-seed of EUR 4M includes EUR 200k public funding from ENISA. Visionaries partner quoted: Robert Jäckle (capital-riesgo.es copy of the company release). Founded 2024 by Jose Ojeda and Álex Valls. Focus: the product is a generative-AI automation platform and AI agent ('Kabi') for accounting firms, so AI & Applied AI; SaaS or Fintech & Payments are the alternatives if the judge reads it as accounting software. Graduation is recent-entry (11 months), so not_graduated means none yet.
